qc/runs/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (header; input_sha256 matches; scope says scripted golden only, no configured judge run)
evidence:
Every plural/exclusive and 'unchanged' wording in all five dimensions was enumerated. Almost all are graded over the whole collection. One 'only' claim is graded with a single forward sample.

PASSING INSTANCES (whole collection or explicit enumeration): gate constraints 'find exactly one card' (gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared) catches a double insert. Functional hro_job_open lists all five refusals (blank title, 0, 51, 2.5, non-manager). hro_add_candidate checks 'in the order added' over all six J1 cards. hro_move_one_stage samples skips in both directions. hro_bulk_all_or_none / hro_bulk_places require 'none of the set moves' and probe the offending card both first and last in board order (B(6), B(10a)). hro_undo_restores reads the whole Applied order (Y, W, X, Z, A2). hro_undo_conflict enumerates move, re-order and reject interference plus the different-card control. hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff and hro_anonymous say 'each' over enumerated request sets (7/7/10 kinds). hro_refusal_status counts only the replays that were refused and defers accepted ones to their own rows (no double penalty). hro_activity covers 'every successful board action ... by any account used in this review' with the protocol letters listed (prompt.md:57), all of that job's lines and only those under the filter, and allows one combined line per multi-card move. hro_activity_refusals covers 'none of the refused attempts'. hro_thread_earlier pages 'until none remain'. hro_candidate_view lists every seeded application of Noor (APP-101 Platform Engineer/Infrastructure/INTERVIEW and APP-302 Product Designer/Design/APPLIED) and of Tomas (APP-201 Data Analyst/Finance Systems/SCREEN plus the new J2 card), matching seed_data.json exactly. hro_candidate_private inspects every response, including stream/socket payloads (prompt.md:51). No seeded message body (12 distinct APP-101 templates plus APP-201/301/302) names another candidate, so the 'no other candidates' guard does not catch legitimate content. hro_restart (lesson 15) records jobs, per-stage order, notes, messages, unread counts and activity lines for all records and compares them after a real restart_app.

'UNCHANGED' GUARDS VS LEGITIMATE SIDE EFFECTS: no guard penalises a legitimate side effect. Unread expectations are state-relative where state can move: Rafael's count uses deltas ('rises by exactly two'), and Mei's count is 'computed from the observed sequence' (judge.toml hro_unread_counts; prompt.md:49), so a staff Conversations view that auto-opens a conversation is tolerated. Lena's absolute '1 unread' is protected: seed reads give USR-CAN3 read_count 2 of 3 on APP-301, and the last message is by USR-REC3, so the expected value is 1. Polish says 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', gates open no conversation, and visual only views as Noor. hro_restart compares against a pre-restart baseline (lesson 16). The global 'refused action must not change any card ...' rule (prompt.md:27) matches rules §3 'Whenever a move is turned down, nothing about the card changes' and §3 Undo 'nothing changes'. The client catch-up after a 409 is a display update, not a change. 'Adding a note doesn't count' is honoured by B(12). The refused-undo legs never consume a later successful undo: L in hro_undo_full, and B(11)/B(10a) are both expected refusals.

DEFECT (instance of the row): hro_reopen (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:103) grades the exclusive claim 'a rejected card can be reopened only to the stage it was rejected from; reopening elsewhere is not offered or is refused'. The public rule is 'reopening takes it back to exactly that stage and nowhere else' (hireops_rules.md:50-51). The only wrong-target probe in the review is protocol M's 'try to reopen C to Screen' (prompt.md:37), and C is rejected from Applied. That makes it one sample, one step forward, from the lowest stage. No card is ever tried at an earlier stage than its rejected-from stage. In R, Rafael's Screen-rejected card is reopened only to its own stage. Ingrid reopens Interview and Offer rejections only to their own stages, and her refused reopen is a role refusal (hro_mgr_early_refused), not a wrong-target probe. So the 'nowhere else' collection is checked at one point, and a whole class of wrong targets (backward) is never exercised. The golden enforces the exact stage (solution/app/src/index.js:252 'if (toStage !== a.rejected_from) reject(... 409 ...)'), so adding a probe cannot hurt Oracle.

Secondary note (not a separate defect): hro_job_open samples the 'hiring manager must be a hiring-manager account' rule with one Recruiter account only (prompt.md:35 'with a Recruiter's account as the hiring manager'). Observer and candidate accounts as manager are never tried. The wording is singular, not an all/only claim, and an app that rejects recruiters but accepts candidates is implausible, so it is recorded only as a sampling note.

Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 1 (no hidden plural demands): every graded collection traces to rules or brief text. Lesson 15: the restart re-reads every record. Lesson 16: no double grading through 'unchanged' guards, and hro_refusal_status and the Activity split avoid it explicitly. No runtime evidence exercises hro_reopen's wrong-target leg. The raw-evidence-index scope says the scripted driver does not walk every Functional criterion, so the gap is NOT EXERCISED, not refuted.
counterexample: An app whose reopen handler accepts any target at or before the rejected-from stage (e.g. `if (STAGES.indexOf(to) > STAGES.indexOf(card.rejected_from)) return 409;`, a plausible 'rewind' design with a stage picker). In the protocol: C (rejected from Applied) reopen to Screen is refused (Screen > Applied), and reopen to Applied works. Undo of the reopen and the reason clearing behave correctly. Ingrid's and Rafael's R reopens target their own stages. hro_reopen therefore scores 1, although a card rejected from Offer could be reopened to Interview or Screen, violating hireops_rules.md:50-51 'exactly that stage and nowhere else'.
suggested_fix: In protocol R, before Ingrid's refused reopen and Rafael's reopen of the Screen-rejected J1 card, have Rafael first try to reopen it to Applied (and to Interview), through the UI or by replay. Both must be refused with the card unchanged. Add 'reopening to an earlier or a later stage (Applied and Screen probes) is refused' to hro_reopen's description so the 'only' claim is checked in both directions.
